messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high error-rate spike detected for model_family=zephyr-13b in us-west-2. 5xx rate up 6x over baseline, request latency climbing. alert_id=ALRT-2026-179995. dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/ALRT-2026-179995 :rotating_light:
ashok: I'm on it. seeing the same on traces. impact looks concentrated to streaming endpoints and higher-context requests.
maria: confirmed. top 3 callers (by env): prod-web, search-embed-job, realtime-chat. prod-web is most affected.
kevin: any customer-facing 503s?
maria: yes — Uptime monitor shows 503 bursts for several customers between 18:09-18:12 PT. not all routes.
ashok: priority mitigation options: 1) reduce RPM for zephyr-13b by 50% 2) lower TPM for that family to limit long context churn 3) temporarily turn off streaming for non-enterprise tenants for zephyr-13b 4) route to fallback model (zephyr-7b) for best-effort tier.
lia: +1 for targeted RPM/TMP reduction first. least risky. can we do per-tier?
maria: we can. config allows model_family + plan-level overrides.
kevin: I'll prep the change. propose: RPM from 12k -> 6k, TPM cap from 250k -> 90k for zephyr-13b, streaming disabled for plan=free/prod-lite. keep enterprise untouched.
ashok: sounds good. also set a 15m automated revert check if errors drop below threshold.
kevin: executing now. running rwctl command:
```
rwctl quota set --model-family zephyr-13b --rpm 6000 --tpm 90000 --streaming false --scope non-enterprise --note "emergency surge control 18:13PT"
```
opsbot: Command queued: rwctl job 98765. will apply to clusters us-west-2 / us-west-1.
kevin: rwctl job 98765 applied to us-west-2 (nodes: gpu-pool-7). change propagated to control-plane, route configs updated.
maria: Observability: 5xx rate down ~40% within 90s. p50 latency down 20%. customer 503 incidents decreased.
nashok: good. start cooldown: monitor for 10 minutes then reassess. log mitigation step in incident runbook.
lia: i'm taking the next on-call shift at 18:30 PT. handing off. notes: mitigation active, rwctl job 98765, revert-check scheduled at 18:28 PT. please msg me if anything regresses.
kevin: added a canary route to route 10% of requests to fallback zephyr-7b for prod-web if error persists. command:
```
rwctl route update --from model_family=zephyr-13b --to model=zephyr-7b --pct 10 --scope prod-web
```
opsbot: Route update applied.
maria: quick customer impact list: customer-alpha (prod-web) saw 503s but recovered post-change. customer-beta (search-embed-job) had delayed jobs; we queued retries. no SLA breaches reported yet.
nashok: reminder to create incident ticket and include transcript + runbook link. also note whether we want permanent quota adjustment after post-mortem.
kevin: logged ticket INC-2026-432 with mitigation details. will attach graphs.
lia: will own post-mortem if still needed. for now monitoring looks stable. I'll escalate to oncall-manager if error rate bounces back.
maria: one follow-up: we should add an automated monitor for long-context token churn to detect similar events earlier. filing a follow-up task.
nashok: thanks team. leaving thread open for 30m.
incident-bot: NOTE: Revert-check scheduled at 18:28 PT (1799955708). will post status.
